brief: Independent CPA serving private clients and small businesses. Evolve the existing bar-chart logo: keep its colours, its bars and its tagline, but turn the generic chart into an ownable mark.
criteria: Success: recognisable to current clients, distinct from generic accounting bar charts, legible at 16 px, works in one colour and reversed.

concepts.name: Yesh — יש
concepts.idea: The familiar bars now spell the word יש: three bars joined into a shin, the short teal bar is the yod — Yossi Shechter's initials and a positive balance.
rationale: Keeps the bars, colours and tagline clients already know
Turns a generic chart into a mark only this office can own
Separate heavier small-size cut for favicons and profile pictures

recommendation: Use the horizontal lockup as the primary logo, the stacked version for square spaces and profile pictures, and the symbol alone for icons.
next_steps: Update website, WhatsApp/Facebook profile and business cards
